children: Fortrea Holdings Inc. reported third-quarter 2026 revenue of $691.5 million, down 1.4% from the prior-year quarter, while net income was $600000 compared with a net loss of $15.9 million. Diluted EPS was $0.01, versus a loss per share of $0.17 a year earlier.
¹ Reported as “Revenues”. ² Reported as “Net income (loss)”. ³ Reported as “Earnings (loss) per common share”.
Nine-month revenue declined 2.7% to $2.0 billion. Lower clinical development revenue and FSP demand outweighed net new business, while clinical pharmacology grew, including pass-through costs.
Restructuring and lower personnel, pass-through, and stock-based compensation costs reduced direct expenses and supported improved cost efficiency.
Backlog was $7.3 billion at September 30, after a $558 million adjustment for estimated changes in contract scope and study delivery requirements.
Fortrea completed its acquisition of Worldwide Clinical Trials’ Early Phase Services division on October 19, broadening its clinical pharmacology capabilities.
